description: Edit any skill bb discovers straight from the sidebar, so a downloaded skill becomes yours before it runs. Every skill on the machine — provider, plugin, built-in, and user — sits in one filterable list. Save carries a revision check, so a file changed on disk is refused instead of overwritten. Create new skills under ~/.bb/skills, search skills.sh, and install registry entries without opening a terminal. Registry search and install need network access to skills.sh; everything else works offline.
